findings.statement: Supersedes the interpretation of R0.3-A-01. Road LTL operational knowledge is split across two governed assets. Completeness must be judged on the composed surface. On the OK payload alone 50/528 cells are satisfied; composed with the governed module layer, 290/528.

Even on the composed governed surface, 64 cells are populated only inside child structures and 174 cells are absent. These are not compliant and were not converted. They are the honest remaining gap surface for R0.4 planning.

66 canonical obj-* identifiers are referenced by governed Road LTL assets and 0 carry an objectSemantics contract. Operational Knowledge Contract v2 requires documents and data objects to be first-class reusable contracts. R0.3 classified this; closing it requires evidenced authoring outside this stage's authority.

76 BOL fields carry a researched performance baseline and 0 carry a conformant Information Resolution Contract v1 record. The researched canonical object model remains DRAFT_RESEARCHED_NOT_PROMOTED and was not promoted.

240 of 528 composed cells are satisfied by DECLARED EQUIVALENT rather than under the contract attribute name. QA should review EQUIVALENCE_MAP in tools/r0-3/ok-hardening.mjs entry by entry. Rejecting any entry moves those cells to ABSENT without invalidating the rest of the matrix.

REGISTRY/CUSTODY SYNCHRONIZATION OUTSTANDING. The Drive durable mirrors 'Atlas Pre-P6 Foundation Recovery Standard V1' and 'Atlas Pre-P6 Recovery Backlog' still read 'Current authorized stage: R0.1C' and 'R0.2 BLOCKED UNTIL R0.1 QA' (last modified 2026-09-08T13:05Z), while the GitHub queue records R0.1C and R0.2 COMPLETE and R0.3 AUTHORIZED. R0.3 did NOT edit them: governance synchronization is not in this stage's scope and the Asset Custody Standard requires governance changes to be written by governance, not by the implementation agent. Recorded here as an outstanding item for QA.

Drive Checkpoint B mirroring did not occur; the connector returned 'No approval received'. GitHub evidence and the CI artifact bundle are retained. Drive candidate custody must be closed before QA disposition.

The stage scope guard initially compared only origin/base...HEAD and therefore passed while a governed pointer was modified in the working tree. It now compares base against the working tree plus untracked files, and was re-verified to fail closed on a deliberate probe edit to governance/frozen-assets/CURRENT.json.

All 14 Checkpoint A inputs remain byte-identical, including the R0.2-certified 1.4 Operational Knowledge (6e5899b2...), 1.4 module (c8a0af37...) and effective 1.5 materialization (a303d30d...). No frozen source asset was mutated.

Out-of-band observation, not R0.3 scope: every push to any branch of this repository triggers a Vercel preview build. 333 preview and 13 production deployment records exist; the last production deployment is 2026-08-25 at main@58b14c7d. The recovery custody protocol's many small commits are a contributor. This is deployment governance, not operational knowledge, and belongs to a separately governed workstream.
